newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MEPC Australia issuing A$150 mln FRN -CBA.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MEPC Australia issuing A$150 mln FRN -CBA.

text.p: MEPC Australia Limited is issuing a fully underwritten A$150 million 3-year floating rate note, lead manager/underwriter Commonwealth Bank of Australia said.
Co-managers are Westpac Banking Corporation and National Australia Bank, which are existing dealers on an outstanding MEPC programme.
The issuer has the right to call the notes at par at any interest rate payment date with three month written notification to the investors and dealers.
Pricing is expected next week, and settlement will be three days after that.
The issue will be rated single A by Standard & Poor's and is fully guaranteed by the parent MEPC Plc, a British property group.

Earlier this month CBA had said the issuer would be looking to refinance an outstanding floating rate note issue maturing in September through its A$500 million medium term note programme which was establised through CBA in 1994.
